detail.body:
## Overview

**NOTE**: This is an AITER ON PR.  The overall goal to make a step towards enabling AITER being turned on for vLLM by default.

With AITER enabled (`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`), these MI300 and MI355 tests fail:

| Test group | Test | GSM8K |
|---|---|---|
| (MI300) LM Eval Small Models | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]` | 0.0000 |
| (MI300) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]` | 0.0000 |
| (MI355) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]` | 0.0000 |
| (MI355) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DiffusionGemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic]` | server fails to start |

The listed test groups and failures were observed:

* `(MI300) LM Eval Small Models`
    * `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]`:
      ```
      (EngineCore pid=8384) ERROR 09-25 23:01:11 [core.py:1438] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (APIServer pid=8097) ERROR 09-25 23:01:11 [async_llm.py:871] vllm.v1.engine.exceptions.EngineDeadError: EngineCore encountered an issue. See stack trace (above) for the root cause.
      FAILED evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py::test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8] - AssertionError: GSM8K metric too low: 0.0000 < 0.7200 - 0.0800 = 0.6400
      ```
* `(MI300) LM Eval Small Models Distributed`
    * `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]`:
      ```
      (EngineCore pid=7516) ERROR 09-25 23:11:07 [core.py:1438] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (APIServer pid=7229) ERROR 09-25 23:11:07 [async_llm.py:871] vllm.v1.engine.exceptions.EngineDeadError: EngineCore encountered an issue. See stack trace (above) for the root cause.
      FAILED evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py::test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8] - AssertionError: GSM8K metric too low: 0.0000 < 0.7200 - 0.0800 = 0.6400
      ```
* `(MI355) LM Eval Small Models Distributed`
    * `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]`:
      ```
      (EngineCore pid=7640) ERROR 09-25 22:56:12 [core.py:1438] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (APIServer pid=7353) ERROR 09-25 22:56:12 [async_llm.py:871] vllm.v1.engine.exceptions.EngineDeadError: EngineCore encountered an issue. See stack trace (above) for the root cause.
      FAILED evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py::test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8] - AssertionError: GSM8K metric too low: 0.0000 < 0.7200 - 0.0800 = 0.6400
      ```
    * `test_gsm8k_correctness[DiffusionGemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic]`:
      ```
      (Worker_TP0 pid=11142) ERROR 10-09 09:03:23 [multiproc_executor.py:948] ValueError: FP8 MoE backend AITER does not support the deployment configuration since kernel does not support MoEActivation.GELU_TANH activation.
      (Worker_TP1 pid=11143) ERROR 10-09 09:03:24 [multiproc_executor.py:948] ValueError: FP8 MoE backend AITER does not support the deployment configuration since kernel does not support MoEActivation.GELU_TANH activation.
      RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {'EngineCore': 1}
      FAILED evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py::test_gsm8k_correctness[DiffusionGemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic] - RuntimeError: Server exited unexpectedly.
      ```

The following related models were also failing when running `vllm serve`:

* `nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8` (compressed-tensors, `CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoEMethod`)
    * TP1:
      ```
      (EngineCore pid=209763) ERROR 10-09 07:08:25 [core.py:1447] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {}
      ```
* `amd/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8` (Quark, `QuarkW8A8Fp8MoEMethod`)
    * TP2:
      ```
      (Worker_TP0 pid=215695) ERROR 10-09 07:15:34 [multiproc_executor.py:1058] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (Worker_TP1 pid=215696) ERROR 10-09 07:15:34 [multiproc_executor.py:1058] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (EngineCore pid=215314) ERROR 10-09 07:15:34 [core.py:1447] RuntimeError: Worker failed with error 'wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem', please check the stack trace above for the root cause
      RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {}
      ```

All four models fail for the same reason. AITER's FP8 MoE kernel only supports
sizes that are multiples of its tile size: the hidden size must be a multiple of
128, and the intermediate size per GPU a multiple of 256 (128 for SwiGLU). Each
of these models has an intermediate size that isn't:

| Model | Class | TP | Intermediate size per GPU | Padded to |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 | `Fp8MoEMethod` | 1 | 1408 | 1536 |
| nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 | `CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoEMethod` | 1 | 1408 | 1536 |
| amd/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8 | `QuarkW8A8Fp8MoEMethod` | 2 | 384 | 512 |
| RedHatAI/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic | `CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoEMethod` | 2 | 352 | 512 |

When AITER is used, this PR pads these sizes up to the next supported size and
fills the padding with zeros, so the results don't change. Sizes that already
fit are left alone.

DiffusionGemma also uses the `gelu_tanh` activation, which vLLM did not pass to
AITER even though AITER supports it. This PR passes it through (see Details).

## Claims

- The failing models pass with AITER on, on MI300X and on MI355X with AITER on and AITER off.
- The failing models now work and are added to the tests and produce passing `lm_eval` scores.
- The failing models can now run vllm serve and vllm bench serve  with AITER on and AITER off.

## Validation

|---|---|
| RedHatAI DeepSeek | RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 |
| nm-testing DeepSeek | nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 |
| AMD Qwen3 | amd/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8 |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | (MI300) LM Eval Small Models | RedHatAI DeepSeek | pass | 0.7847 | pass | 0.7908 | fail | 0.0000 |
| 2 | (MI300) LM Eval Small Models | nm-testing DeepSeek | pass | 0.7786 | pass | 0.7794 | fail | 0.0000 |
| 3 | (MI300) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | RedHatAI DeepSeek | pass | 0.7832 | pass | 0.7915 | fail | 0.0000 |
| 4 | (MI300) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | AMD Qwen3 (TP2) | pass | 0.8484 | pass | 0.8309 | fail | server fails to start |
| 5 | (MI355) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | RedHatAI DeepSeek | pass | 0.7801 | pass | 0.7817 | fail | 0.0000 |
| 6 | (MI355) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | AMD Qwen3 (TP2) | pass | 0.8491 | pass | 0.8385 | fail | server fails to start |
| 7 | (MI355) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | RedHatAI DiffusionGemma (TP2) | pass | 0.9280 | pass | 0.9257 | fail | server fails to start |

Pass/fail and GSM8K scores are from running the commands below. 
Models added were ran without the rest of the PR update.

* Row 1
    * `pytest`:
      ```
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 pytest -s -v tests/evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py --config-list-file=configs/models-small.txt -k 'DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 and not FP8-CT'

      ```

      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=0 pytest -s -v tests/evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py --config-list-file=configs/models-small.txt -k 'FP8-CT'

      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=0 pytest -s -v tests/evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py --config-list-file=configs/models-mi3xx-fp8-and-mixed.txt -k 'Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8-TP2'

+def fp8_moe_round_up_sizes(
+    activation: MoEActivation,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    intermediate_size: int,
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Round hidden up to 128 and intermediate up to 256 (128 for SwiGLU) for
+    AITER's FP8 MoE kernel."""
+    intermediate_alignment = (
+        128
+        if activation in (MoEActivation.SWIGLUOAI, MoEActivation.SWIGLUOAI_UNINTERLEAVE)
+        else 256
+    )
+    return round_up(hidden_size, 128), round_up(
+        intermediate_size, intermediate_alignment
+    )
+
+
+def maybe_round_up_hidden_size_and_intermediate_size(
+    backend: Fp8MoeBackend,
+    weight_key: QuantKey | None,
+    activation: MoEActivation,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    intermediate_size: int,
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Round up dimensions before allocation to satisfy the selected kernel.
+    The padded weights must be zero-initialized."""
+    # These run on AITER's CK GEMM, which needs aligned sizes.
+    if backend == Fp8MoeBackend.AITER and (
+        weight_key == kFp8StaticTensorSym
+        or (
+            weight_key == kFp8StaticChannelSym
+            and activation == MoEActivation.GELU_TANH
+        )
+    ):
+        return fp8_moe_round_up_sizes(activation, hidden_size, intermediate_size)
+    return hidden_size, intermediate_size
+
+
+def maybe_zero_moe_weight_padding(
+    moe_config: FusedMoEConfig,
+    w13: torch.Tensor,
+    w2: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """Zero the padding added by maybe_roundup_sizes, since the loader only
+    fills the checkpoint's part of the weights."""
+    inter = moe_config.intermediate_size_per_partition_unpadded
+    inter_padded = moe_config.intermediate_size_per_partition
+    hidden = moe_config.hidden_dim_unpadded
+    hidden_padded = moe_config.hidden_dim
+    assert inter is not None and hidden is not None, (
+        f"The unpadded MoE sizes are not set (inter={inter}, hidden={hidden})."
+    )
+    if inter_padded > inter:
+        w13[:, inter:inter_padded].zero_()
+        if moe_config.is_act_and_mul:
+            w13[:, inter_padded + inter :].zero_()
+        w2[:, :, inter:].zero_()
+    if hidden_padded > hidden:
+        w13[:, :, hidden:].zero_()
+        w2[:, hidden:].zero_()
